description: Symbolic derivation of the single unified matter metric, spatially covariant ADM/DHOST gravitational action on static space, shared GW/EM wave operator Box_TEP across both N_TEP and A_sp (GW170817 offset == 0.0 s), WKB Hubble-friction absence preserving Xi(z) = d_L^GW / d_L^EM = 1/(1+z), and PPN gravitational slip gamma_PPN.

unified_metric_verification.covariant_formula: g_tilde_munu = -A_loc^2(u_grav(x)) U_mu U_nu + A_sp^2(u_drift(t, x)) Pi_munu + B(phi) Pi_mu^a Pi_nu^b d_a phi d_b phi
unified_metric_verification.line_element_adm: d s_tilde^2 = -N_TEP^2(x) c^2 dt^2 + A_sp^2(t, x) gamma_{ij}(x) dx^i dx^j

action_variation_results.gravitational_action_ADM_DHOST: S_grav = (M_Pl^2 / 2) int d^3x dt sqrt(gamma) N_GR [ R_scalar^{(3)}(gamma) + A_sp^{-1}(t,x) R_TT^{(3)}(gamma) + (A_sp(t,x) / A_loc^2(u_grav)) (K_{ij} K^{ij} - K^2) ] == (M_Pl^2 / 2) int d^3x dt sqrt(gamma) N_GR [ R_scalar^{(3)}(gamma) + A_sp^{-1}(t,x) R_TT^{(3)}(gamma) + K_tilde_{ij} K_tilde^{ij} - K_tilde^2 ]

quadratic_svt_curvature_definitions.R_scalar_3_definition: R_scalar^{(3)}(gamma) = (4/c^2) nabla^2 Phi_N - (2/c^4)(nabla Phi_N)^2 (integrating sqrt(gamma) N_GR R_scalar^{(3)} by parts yields -2 (nabla Phi_N / c^2)^2)
quadratic_svt_curvature_definitions.R_TT_3_definition: R_TT^{(3)}(gamma) = -(1/4) gamma^{kl} d_k h_{ij}^{TT} d_l h_{ij}^{TT}
quadratic_svt_curvature_definitions.local_khronon_covariant_formulation: In the covariant khronon / preferred-foliation framework (Blas, Pujolas & Sibiryakov 2010) defined by the unit timelike gradient U_mu = -d_mu phi / sqrt(2 X) and spatial acceleration 3-vector a_i = U^nu nabla_nu U_i = D_i ln N_GR = d_i Phi_N / c^2, the longitudinal potential piece is represented by the strictly LOCAL operator a_i a^i = gamma^{ij} D_i ln N_GR D_j ln N_GR: S_grav^{khronon} = (M_Pl^2/2) int d^3x dt sqrt(gamma) N_GR [ A_sp^{-1} R^{(3)}(gamma) + 2 (A_sp^{-1} - 1) gamma^{ij} D_i ln N_GR D_j ln N_GR + K_tilde_{ij} K_tilde^{ij} - K_tilde^2 ], which is 100% local (requiring no inverse Laplacian) and reproduces R_scalar^{(3)} + A_sp^{-1} R_TT^{(3)} identically at quadratic order.

preferred_frame_ppn_parameters.foliation_vector_status: Covariant dynamical unit normal U_mu = -d_mu bar_phi / sqrt(2 bar_X) of the time-field gradient (not a fixed prior-geometry background vector); matching the boosted metric g_tilde_0i = -2 beta_A u(r) w_i/c and g_tilde_00 to Will (2014) PPN potentials separates the intrinsic screened coefficients alpha_1^intrinsic(r), alpha_2^intrinsic(r) from the (w_CMB/c)^2 frame-projected observables.

galaxy_scale_lensing_dynamics_consistenc.outskirt_weak_lensing_mistele_2024_consi: The unstretched-space temporal metric at fixed epoch (A_sp = 1) fixes distinct direct weights: the local temporal-depth perturbation u_grav enters slow-matter dynamics at full strength (Phi_dyn = Phi_N + beta_A c^2 u) and direct ray refraction n(x) = 1 - 2 Phi_N/c^2 - beta_A u at half the GR potential weight (Phi_lens = Phi_N + beta_A c^2 u/2, the 1x pure temporal-lapse benchmark, giving M_lens^GR/M_dyn = (1 + x)/(1 + 2x) with x = beta_A^2 y_eff and gamma_SMP = 1/(1 + 2 beta_A^2 y_eff) < 1 wherever the local scalar is unscreened), while dynamical/virial-calibrated lens reconstructions and chronometric mass-sheet mappings read the 2x dynamical-equivalent normalization (Papers 4, 18, 19). For ESO 325-G004 the isolated branch gives gamma = 0.767 (2.26 sigma below Collett's 0.97 +/- 0.09) - the correct isolated-environment prediction and a falsifiable discriminator for isolated field lenses - but E325 is group-central: under the nested two-body operator (step_30) the group-halo ambient kinetic value suppresses the incremental local response to y_eff ~ 7.3e-03-1.6e-03 (halo-profile ambient X_group ~ 1e2) giving gamma ~ 0.99, or gamma ~ 0.83-0.98 under the effective-ambient convention X_group ~ 3-100; the 1-sigma floor requires only X_group >= 8.1.

standard_siren_homogeneous_consistency.homogeneous_metric: d s_tilde^2 = -c^2 dt^2 + A_sp^2(t) gamma_{ij} dx^i dx^j (for u_grav = 0)
standard_siren_homogeneous_consistency.conformal_time_null_cone: d eta = dt / A_sp(t) => dx / d eta = c for both EM and GW (Delta t_{gamma-GW} == 0)
standard_siren_homogeneous_consistency.wkb_tensor_measure_on_static_space: sqrt(A_sp^{+1} * A_sp^{-1}) == 1 (zero Hubble friction vs FLRW a^2(eta) measure)

verdict.summary: The single unified matter metric g_tilde_munu = -A_loc^2(u_grav) U_mu U_nu + A_sp^2(u_drift) Pi_munu + B(phi) Pi_mu^a Pi_nu^b d_a phi d_b phi (d s_tilde^2 = -N_TEP^2(x) c^2 dt^2 + A_sp^2(t,x) gamma_{ij}(x) dx^i dx^j) and spatially covariant ADM/DHOST gravitational action S_grav = (M_Pl^2/2) int d^3x dt sqrt(gamma) N_GR [R_scalar^{(3)}(gamma) + A_sp^{-1} R_TT^{(3)}(gamma) + (A_sp/A_loc^2)(K_{ij}K^{ij} - K^2)] simultaneously (1) preserve the quasistatic Poisson equation and scalar source equation without Jordan-frame degeneracy (dL_grav/du == 0, dL_grav/dA_sp == 0 at K_{ij} -> 0), (2) yield identical GW and EM wave operators Box_TEP = -(N_TEP c)^{-2} d_t^2 + A_sp^{-2} gamma^{kl} d_k d_l with c_GW(t,x) = c_gamma(t,x) = c N_TEP / A_sp everywhere (Delta t_{gamma-GW} == 0.0 s for GW170817) and shared refractive index n(x) = 1 - 2 Phi_N/c^2 - beta_A u_grav(x) at A_sp = 1, (3) give the PPN slip gamma_PPN - 1 = -2 beta_A^2 S_Sigma / (1 + 2 beta_A^2 S_Sigma) < 0 (|gamma_PPN - 1| ~= 4.32e-08 << 2.3e-5 at 1.6 R_sun on the selected two-branch sector), and (4) keep the WKB tensor measure sqrt(A_sp^{+1} * A_sp^{-1}) == 1 constant on static space (sqrt(gamma) = 1), eliminating FLRW Hubble friction and preserving Xi(z) = d_L^GW / d_L^EM = 1 / (1 + z) != 1 alongside 100% of the Hubble law and the operative Cassini-compatible screened-branch LLR drift |Gdot_loc/G_loc|_LLR ~ 1.7e-18 yr^-1 (reference-quartic secant ceiling 2.85e-13 yr^-1 < 4e-13 yr^-1).
